properties.name: The clean sync line says what a node count cannot see
properties.rationale:
The defect was never that the check is incomplete — it is that its quiet read as a guarantee. All three bounds were already written down in the Rust doc comment, which is exactly where no agent and no user has ever read them; that is fact:vocabulary-needs-three-legs-and-a-users-project-gets-none-of-it happening inside reflow2's own code.

⭐ FOURTH INSTANCE OF A PATTERN THIS PROJECT HAS ALREADY CHOSEN THREE TIMES, which is why it was preferred over new machinery: open_questions carries a loop_hint so count 0 cannot read as an all-clear; detect_defects carries swept.note and coverage_note naming what a sweep could not have found; detect_gaps reports share_of_anchored so a narrowed answer cannot pass as the whole. A reply that cannot tell "nothing to report" from "nothing I can see" has to say which it is.

🛑 WHAT WAS DELIBERATELY NOT BUILT, and why, is on dec:the-unexported-work-check-keeps-its-node-count-and-says-so (accepted, Anthony 2026-08-31): write_gen is rejected outright because it resets on restart and would produce a FALSE ALL-CLEAR, and no second detector is built because reflow2_check.py already fails the build on a checksum_change. The counter-argument is recorded there too — that gate fires only at commit time and only over registered artifacts, so the uncovered cases are named rather than papered over.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: sync_debt's in-step message used to read "X is exactly where this graph left it." full stop, so its silence was taken as "everything of mine is in that file". It never could promise that: the comparison counts NODES, so a write that changed only a property or only an edge leaves both counts equal and lands in that arm looking settled. The line now names the instrument and both shapes it is blind to, and carries the measured 0-of-10. Pinned by the_in_step_line_says_what_a_node_count_cannot_see, alongside the existing counterweight test that the same arm must still raise no alarm. The third bound is also added to SyncDebt::export_nodes's doc comment, which previously stated only two.
